test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

She has ______ her money and jewellery to help the poor.
solution: The correct answer is option 2), i.e., 'given away.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the **meaning **of the phrasal verbs given in the options: • **given up** - to abandon or surrender. (छोड़ देना) • **given away** - to donate or give something as a gift. (दान करना) • **given in** - to submit or yield to something. (मान लेना) • **given way** - to collapse or break down. (टूट जाना) • The context of the sentence is that the subject of the sentence has donated or given her money and jewellery for free to help poor people. • According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "given away." • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2. • Another example: • *All the books were **given away** free.* Complete Sentence:__ *She has __given away__ her money and jewellery to help the poor.* 1c1:T101d6,
